passages.text: “Next, have your brother Aaron brought to you from among the Israelites, along with his sons Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar, to serve Me as priests.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Moses.
God told Moses to bring Aaron to him.
Aaron is Moses’ brother.
God told Moses to bring Aaron’s sons with him.
Aaron’s sons are Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
God told Moses to choose them from among the Israelites.
God chose Aaron and his sons to serve Him as priests.
passages.original: וְאַתָּ֡ה הַקְרֵ֣ב אֵלֶיךָ֩ אֶת־ אַהֲרֹ֨ן אָחִ֜יךָ וְאֶת־ בָּנָ֣יו אִתּ֔וֹ מִתּ֛וֹךְ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְכַהֲנוֹ־ לִ֑י אַהֲרֹ֕ן נָדָ֧ב וַאֲבִיה֛וּא אֶלְעָזָ֥ר וְאִיתָמָ֖ר בְּנֵ֥י אַהֲרֹֽן׃

passages.text: Make holy garments for your brother Aaron, to give him glory and splendor.
passages.sermon:
God chose Aaron to serve as priest.
Aaron is your brother.
God commanded you to make special garments for Aaron.
These garments are holy.
These garments will give Aaron glory.
These garments will give Aaron splendor.
passages.original: וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ בִגְדֵי־ קֹ֖דֶשׁ לְאַהֲרֹ֣ן אָחִ֑יךָ לְכָב֖וֹד וּלְתִפְאָֽרֶת׃

passages.text: You are to instruct all the skilled craftsmen, whom I have filled with a spirit of wisdom, to make garments for Aaron’s consecration, so that he may serve Me as priest.
passages.sermon:
God chose Moses to lead the Israelites.
God told Moses to speak to all the skilled craftsmen.
God filled these craftsmen with a spirit of wisdom.
God wanted these craftsmen to make special garments for Aaron.
These garments would set Aaron apart.
These garments would prepare Aaron to serve God as priest.
passages.original: וְאַתָּ֗ה תְּדַבֵּר֙ אֶל־ כָּל־ חַכְמֵי־ לֵ֔ב אֲשֶׁ֥ר מִלֵּאתִ֖יו ר֣וּחַ חָכְמָ֑ה וְעָשׂ֞וּ אֶת־ בִּגְדֵ֧י אַהֲרֹ֛ן לְקַדְּשׁ֖וֹ לְכַהֲנוֹ־ לִֽי׃

passages.text: These are the garments that they shall make: a breastpiece, an ephod, a robe, a woven tunic, a turban, and a sash. They are to make these holy garments for your brother Aaron and his sons, so that they may serve Me as priests.
passages.sermon:
God gave instructions for special clothing.
These garments are for Aaron and his sons.
Aaron is Moses’ brother.
Aaron and his sons will serve God as priests.
The craftsmen must make these garments.
The garments are a breastpiece, an ephod, a robe, a woven tunic, a turban, and a sash.
These garments are holy.
The garments set Aaron and his sons apart to serve God.
passages.original: וְאֵ֨לֶּה הַבְּגָדִ֜ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר יַעֲשׂ֗וּ חֹ֤שֶׁן וְאֵפוֹד֙ וּמְעִ֔יל וּכְתֹ֥נֶת תַּשְׁבֵּ֖ץ מִצְנֶ֣פֶת וְאַבְנֵ֑ט וְעָשׂ֨וּ בִגְדֵי־ קֹ֜דֶשׁ לְאַהֲרֹ֥ן אָחִ֛יךָ וּלְבָנָ֖יו לְכַהֲנוֹ־ לִֽי׃

passages.text: They shall use gold, along with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and fine linen.
passages.sermon:
The skilled craftsmen will take materials.
They will take gold.
They will take blue yarn.
They will take purple yarn.
They will take scarlet yarn.
They will take fine linen.
They will use these materials.
passages.original: וְהֵם֙ יִקְח֣וּ אֶת־ הַזָּהָ֔ב וְאֶת־ הַתְּכֵ֖לֶת וְאֶת־ הָֽאַרְגָּמָ֑ן וְאֶת־ תּוֹלַ֥עַת הַשָּׁנִ֖י וְאֶת־ הַשֵּֽׁשׁ׃פ

passages.text: They are to make the ephod of finely spun linen embroidered with gold, and with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn.
passages.sermon:
God commanded the Israelites to make special garments for the priests.
The ephod is one of these garments.
They must make the ephod from finely spun linen.
They must embroider the ephod with gold.
They must also use blue yarn.
They must use purple yarn.
They must use scarlet yarn.
Skilled workers must make the ephod.
passages.original: וְעָשׂ֖וּ אֶת־ הָאֵפֹ֑ד זָ֠הָב תְּכֵ֨לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָ֜ן תּוֹלַ֧עַת שָׁנִ֛י וְשֵׁ֥שׁ מָשְׁזָ֖ר מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה חֹשֵֽׁב׃

passages.text: It shall have two shoulder pieces attached at two of its corners, so it can be fastened.
passages.sermon:
The ephod is a special garment for the high priest.
The ephod must have two shoulder pieces.
The shoulder pieces must be attached at the two corners of the ephod.
These shoulder pieces will fasten the ephod together.
passages.original: שְׁתֵּ֧י כְתֵפֹ֣ת חֹֽבְרֹ֗ת יִֽהְיֶה־ לּ֛וֹ אֶל־ שְׁנֵ֥י קְצוֹתָ֖יו וְחֻבָּֽר׃

passages.text: And the skillfully woven waistband of the ephod must be of one piece, of the same workmanship—with gold, with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and with finely spun linen.
passages.sermon:
The ephod is a special garment for the high priest.
The ephod has a waistband.
The waistband must be skillfully woven.
The waistband must be made as one piece.
The waistband must have the same workmanship as the ephod.
The waistband must use gold.
The waistband must use blue yarn.
The waistband must use purple yarn.
The waistband must use scarlet yarn.
The waistband must use finely spun linen.
passages.original: וְחֵ֤שֶׁב אֲפֻדָּתוֹ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָלָ֔יו כְּמַעֲשֵׂ֖הוּ מִמֶּ֣נּוּ יִהְיֶ֑ה זָהָ֗ב תְּכֵ֧לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָ֛ן וְתוֹלַ֥עַת שָׁנִ֖י וְשֵׁ֥שׁ מָשְׁזָֽר׃

passages.text: Take two onyx stones and engrave on them the names of the sons of Israel: six of their names on one stone and the remaining six on the other, in the order of their birth.
passages.sermon:
Take two onyx stones.
Engrave the names of the sons of Israel on these stones.
Write six names on one stone.
Write the other six names on the second stone.
Arrange the names in the order of their birth.
passages.original: וְלָ֣קַחְתָּ֔ אֶת־ שְׁתֵּ֖י אַבְנֵי־ שֹׁ֑הַם וּפִתַּחְתָּ֣ עֲלֵיהֶ֔ם שְׁמ֖וֹת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ שִׁשָּׁה֙ מִשְּׁמֹתָ֔ם עַ֖ל הָאֶ֣בֶן הָאֶחָ֑ת וְאֶת־ שְׁמ֞וֹת הַשִּׁשָּׁ֧ה הַנּוֹתָרִ֛ים עַל־ הָאֶ֥בֶן הַשֵּׁנִ֖ית כְּתוֹלְדֹתָֽם׃

passages.text: Engrave the names of the sons of Israel on the two stones the way a gem cutter engraves a seal. Then mount the stones in gold filigree settings.
passages.sermon:
A skilled craftsman must engrave two stones.
He must engrave the stones with the names of the sons of Israel.
He must engrave the stones as a gem cutter engraves a seal.
He must set the engraved stones in gold filigree settings.
passages.original: מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה חָרַשׁ֮ אֶבֶן֒ פִּתּוּחֵ֣י חֹתָ֗ם תְּפַתַּח֙ אֶת־ שְׁתֵּ֣י הָאֲבָנִ֔ים עַל־ שְׁמֹ֖ת בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל מֻסַבֹּ֛ת מִשְׁבְּצ֥וֹת זָהָ֖ב תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה אֹתָֽם׃

passages.text: Fasten both stones on the shoulder pieces of the ephod as memorial stones for the sons of Israel. Aaron is to bear their names on his two shoulders as a memorial before the LORD.
passages.sermon:
God gave instructions for the high priest’s garments.
Aaron was the first high priest of Israel.
Take two onyx stones.
Engrave the names of the sons of Israel on these stones.
Fasten both stones onto the shoulder pieces of the ephod.
The ephod is a special garment for the high priest.
These stones are memorial stones for the sons of Israel.
Aaron will carry their names on his two shoulders.
He will do this as a memorial before the LORD.
passages.original: וְשַׂמְתָּ֞ אֶת־ שְׁתֵּ֣י הָאֲבָנִ֗ים עַ֚ל כִּתְפֹ֣ת הָֽאֵפֹ֔ד אַבְנֵ֥י זִכָּרֹ֖ן לִבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְנָשָׂא֩ אַהֲרֹ֨ן אֶת־ שְׁמוֹתָ֜ם לִפְנֵ֧י יְהוָ֛ה עַל־ שְׁתֵּ֥י כְתֵפָ֖יו לְזִכָּרֹֽן׃ס

passages.text: Fashion gold filigree settings and two chains of pure gold, made of braided cord work; and attach these chains to the settings.
passages.sermon:
Make gold settings.
Make two chains from pure gold.
Use braided cord work for the chains.
Attach the braided gold chains to the gold settings.
passages.original: וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ מִשְׁבְּצֹ֖ת זָהָֽב׃ וּשְׁתֵּ֤י שַׁרְשְׁרֹת֙ זָהָ֣ב טָה֔וֹר מִגְבָּלֹ֛ת תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה אֹתָ֖ם מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה עֲבֹ֑ת וְנָתַתָּ֛ה אֶת־ שַׁרְשְׁרֹ֥ת הָעֲבֹתֹ֖ת עַל־ הַֽמִּשְׁבְּצֹֽת׃ס

passages.text: You are also to make a breastpiece of judgment with the same workmanship as the ephod. Construct it with gold, with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and with finely spun linen.
passages.sermon:
God commanded Moses to make a breastpiece of judgment for Aaron the high priest.
Make the breastpiece with skilled workmanship.
Use the same workmanship as the ephod.
Make the breastpiece from gold.
Use blue yarn.
Use purple yarn.
Use scarlet yarn.
Use finely spun linen.
Construct the breastpiece from these materials.
passages.original: וְעָשִׂ֜יתָ חֹ֤שֶׁן מִשְׁפָּט֙ מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה חֹשֵׁ֔ב כְּמַעֲשֵׂ֥ה אֵפֹ֖ד תַּעֲשֶׂ֑נּוּ זָ֠הָב תְּכֵ֨לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָ֜ן וְתוֹלַ֧עַת שָׁנִ֛י וְשֵׁ֥שׁ מָשְׁזָ֖ר תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה אֹתֽוֹ׃

passages.text: It must be square when folded over double, a span long and a span wide.
passages.sermon:
The breastpiece must be square.
Fold the breastpiece over double.
The breastpiece must be a span long.
The breastpiece must be a span wide.
passages.original: רָב֥וּעַ יִֽהְיֶ֖ה כָּפ֑וּל זֶ֥רֶת אָרְכּ֖וֹ וְזֶ֥רֶת רָחְבּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: And mount on it a setting of gemstones, four rows of stones: In the first row there shall be a ruby, a topaz, and an emerald; in the second row a turquoise, a sapphire, and a diamond; in the third row a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst; and in the fourth row a beryl, an onyx, and a jasper. Mount these stones in gold filigree settings.
passages.sermon:
God commanded Moses to make a special breastpiece for the high priest.
This breastpiece must have gemstones set into it.
There must be four rows of stones on the breastpiece.
The first row must have a ruby, a topaz, and an emerald.
The second row must have a turquoise, a sapphire, and a diamond.
The third row must have a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst.
The fourth row must have a beryl, an onyx, and a jasper.
Set all these stones in gold filigree settings.
passages.original: וּמִלֵּאתָ֥ בוֹ֙ מִלֻּ֣אַת אֶ֔בֶן אַרְבָּעָ֖ה טוּרִ֣ים אָ֑בֶן ט֗וּר אֹ֤דֶם פִּטְדָה֙ וּבָרֶ֔קֶת הַטּ֖וּר הָאֶחָֽד׃ וְהַטּ֖וּר הַשֵּׁנִ֑י נֹ֥פֶךְ סַפִּ֖יר וְיָהֲלֹֽם׃ וְהַטּ֖וּר הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֑י לֶ֥שֶׁם שְׁב֖וֹ וְאַחְלָֽמָה׃ וְהַטּוּר֙ הָרְבִיעִ֔י תַּרְשִׁ֥ישׁ וְשֹׁ֖הַם וְיָשְׁפֵ֑ה מְשֻׁבָּצִ֥ים זָהָ֛ב יִהְי֖וּ בְּמִלּוּאֹתָֽם׃

passages.text: The twelve stones are to correspond to the names of the sons of Israel, each engraved like a seal with the name of one of the twelve tribes.
passages.sermon:
There are twelve stones.
Each stone stands for one of the sons of Israel.
Each stone has a name on it.
The name is engraved like a seal.
Each name is for one of the twelve tribes of Israel.
passages.original: וְ֠הָאֲבָנִים תִּֽהְיֶ֜יןָ עַל־ שְׁמֹ֧ת בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל שְׁתֵּ֥ים עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה עַל־ שְׁמֹתָ֑ם פִּתּוּחֵ֤י חוֹתָם֙ אִ֣ישׁ עַל־ שְׁמ֔וֹ תִּֽהְיֶ֕יןָ לִשְׁנֵ֥י עָשָׂ֖ר שָֽׁבֶט׃

passages.text: For the breastpiece, make braided chains like cords of pure gold.
passages.sermon:
God commanded Moses to make a special breastpiece for the high priest.
The breastpiece must have chains.
Make the chains braided.
Make the chains like cords.
Use pure gold to make the chains.
passages.original: וְעָשִׂ֧יתָ עַל־ הַחֹ֛שֶׁן שַֽׁרְשֹׁ֥ת גַּבְלֻ֖ת מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה עֲבֹ֑ת זָהָ֖ב טָהֽוֹר׃

passages.text: You are also to make two gold rings and fasten them to the two corners of the breastpiece.
passages.sermon:
God commanded Moses to make a special breastpiece for the high priest.
The breastpiece must have two gold rings.
Make the two gold rings.
Attach the two gold rings to the two corners of the breastpiece.
passages.original: וְעָשִׂ֙יתָ֙ עַל־ הַחֹ֔שֶׁן שְׁתֵּ֖י טַבְּע֣וֹת זָהָ֑ב וְנָתַתָּ֗ אֶת־ שְׁתֵּי֙ הַטַּבָּע֔וֹת עַל־ שְׁנֵ֖י קְצ֥וֹת הַחֹֽשֶׁן׃

passages.text: Then fasten the two gold chains to the two gold rings at the corners of the breastpiece, and fasten the other ends of the two chains to the two filigree settings, attaching them to the shoulder pieces of the ephod at the front.
passages.sermon:
The breastpiece is a special garment for the high priest.
It has two gold rings at its corners.
Take two gold chains.
Fasten each gold chain to a gold ring at the corners of the breastpiece.
Each gold chain has two ends.
Take the other ends of the two gold chains.
Attach these ends to two filigree settings.
The filigree settings are on the shoulder pieces of the ephod.
Place the filigree settings at the front of the ephod.
Fasten the gold chains to the filigree settings on the shoulder pieces.
passages.original: וְנָתַתָּ֗ה אֶת־ שְׁתֵּי֙ עֲבֹתֹ֣ת הַזָּהָ֔ב עַל־ שְׁתֵּ֖י הַטַּבָּעֹ֑ת אֶל־ קְצ֖וֹת הַחֹֽשֶׁן׃ וְאֵ֨ת שְׁתֵּ֤י קְצוֹת֙ שְׁתֵּ֣י הָעֲבֹתֹ֔ת תִּתֵּ֖ן עַל־ שְׁתֵּ֣י הַֽמִּשְׁבְּצ֑וֹת וְנָתַתָּ֛ה עַל־ כִּתְפ֥וֹת הָאֵפֹ֖ד אֶל־ מ֥וּל פָּנָֽיו׃

passages.text: Make two more gold rings and attach them to the other two corners of the breastpiece, on the inside edge next to the ephod.
passages.sermon:
God gave instructions for making the priestly garments.
The breastpiece is a special part of these garments.
Make two gold rings.
Attach these rings to the other two corners of the breastpiece.
Place the rings on the inside edge of the breastpiece.
This edge is next to the ephod.
passages.original: וְעָשִׂ֗יתָ שְׁתֵּי֙ טַבְּע֣וֹת זָהָ֔ב וְשַׂמְתָּ֣ אֹתָ֔ם עַל־ שְׁנֵ֖י קְצ֣וֹת הַחֹ֑שֶׁן עַל־ שְׂפָת֕וֹ אֲשֶׁ֛ר אֶל־ עֵ֥בֶר הָאֵפֹ֖ד בָּֽיְתָה׃

passages.text: Make two additional gold rings and attach them to the bottom of the two shoulder pieces of the ephod, on its front, near its seam just above its woven waistband.
passages.sermon:
God gave Moses instructions for making the ephod.
The ephod is a special garment for the high priest.
Make two gold rings.
Use pure gold for these rings.
Attach the two gold rings to the ephod.
Place one ring on each shoulder piece of the ephod.
Put the rings at the bottom of the shoulder pieces.
Position the rings on the front side of the ephod.
Set the rings near the seam of the ephod.
The seam is just above the woven waistband of the ephod.
passages.original: וְעָשִׂיתָ֮ שְׁתֵּ֣י טַבְּע֣וֹת זָהָב֒ וְנָתַתָּ֣ה אֹתָ֡ם עַל־ שְׁתֵּי֩ כִתְפ֨וֹת הָאֵפ֤וֹד מִלְּמַ֙טָּה֙ מִמּ֣וּל פָּנָ֔יו לְעֻמַּ֖ת מֶחְבַּרְתּ֑וֹ מִמַּ֕עַל לְחֵ֖שֶׁב הָאֵפֽוֹד׃

passages.text: The rings of the breastpiece shall be tied to the rings of the ephod with a cord of blue yarn, so that the breastpiece is above the waistband of the ephod and does not swing out from the ephod.
passages.sermon:
The breastpiece has rings.
The ephod has rings.
Tie the rings of the breastpiece to the rings of the ephod.
Use a cord of blue yarn to tie them.
The breastpiece must stay above the waistband of the ephod.
The breastpiece must not swing out from the ephod.
passages.original: וְיִרְכְּס֣וּ אֶת־ הַ֠חֹשֶׁן מִטַּבְּעֹתוֹ אֶל־ טַבְּעֹ֤ת הָאֵפֹד֙ בִּפְתִ֣יל תְּכֵ֔לֶת לִֽהְי֖וֹת עַל־ חֵ֣שֶׁב הָאֵפ֑וֹד וְלֹֽא־ יִזַּ֣ח הַחֹ֔שֶׁן מֵעַ֖ל הָאֵפֽוֹד׃

passages.text: Whenever Aaron enters the Holy Place, he shall bear the names of the sons of Israel over his heart on the breastpiece of judgment, as a continual reminder before the LORD.
passages.sermon:
Aaron is the high priest of Israel.
Aaron enters the Holy Place.
Aaron wears the breastpiece of judgment.
The breastpiece of judgment rests over Aaron’s heart.
The names of the sons of Israel are on the breastpiece of judgment.
Aaron carries these names over his heart.
Aaron does this every time he enters the Holy Place.
This act serves as a continual reminder before the LORD.
passages.original: וְנָשָׂ֣א אַ֠הֲרֹן אֶת־ שְׁמ֨וֹת בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל בְּחֹ֧שֶׁן הַמִּשְׁפָּ֛ט עַל־ לִבּ֖וֹ בְּבֹא֣וֹ אֶל־ הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ לְזִכָּרֹ֥ן לִפְנֵֽי־ יְהוָ֖ה תָּמִֽיד׃

passages.text: And place the Urim and Thummim in the breastpiece of judgment, so that they will also be over Aaron’s heart whenever he comes before the LORD. Aaron will continually carry the judgment of the sons of Israel over his heart before the LORD.
passages.sermon:
God chose Aaron to serve as high priest.
Aaron must wear special garments when he comes before the LORD.
The breastpiece of judgment is one of these garments.
Place the Urim and Thummim inside the breastpiece of judgment.
The Urim and Thummim will rest over Aaron’s heart.
Aaron will come before the LORD with the Urim and Thummim over his heart.
Aaron will always carry the judgment of the sons of Israel over his heart before the LORD.
passages.original: וְנָתַתָּ֞ אֶל־ חֹ֣שֶׁן הַמִּשְׁפָּ֗ט אֶת־ הָאוּרִים֙ וְאֶת־ הַתֻּמִּ֔ים וְהָיוּ֙ עַל־ לֵ֣ב אַהֲרֹ֔ן בְּבֹא֖וֹ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְנָשָׂ֣א אַ֠הֲרֹן אֶת־ מִשְׁפַּ֨ט בְּנֵי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֧ל עַל־ לִבּ֛וֹ לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה תָּמִֽיד׃ס

passages.text: You are to make the robe of the ephod entirely of blue cloth, with an opening at its top in the center. Around the opening shall be a woven collar with an opening like that of a garment, so that it will not tear.
passages.sermon:
God gave instructions for Aaron, the high priest of Israel.
Make the robe for the ephod.
Use only blue cloth for this robe.
Make an opening at the top of the robe.
Place this opening in the center of the robe.
Make a collar around the opening.
Weave the collar as a craftsman weaves cloth.
Shape the collar like the opening of a garment.
This collar will keep the robe from tearing.
passages.original: וְעָשִׂ֛יתָ אֶת־ מְעִ֥יל הָאֵפ֖וֹד כְּלִ֥יל תְּכֵֽלֶת׃ וְהָיָ֥ה פִֽי־ רֹאשׁ֖וֹ בְּתוֹכ֑וֹ שָׂפָ֡ה יִֽהְיֶה֩ לְפִ֨יו סָבִ֜יב מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה אֹרֵ֗ג כְּפִ֥י תַחְרָ֛א יִֽהְיֶה־ לּ֖וֹ לֹ֥א יִקָּרֵֽעַ׃

passages.text: Make pomegranates of blue, purple, and scarlet yarn all the way around the lower hem, with gold bells between them, alternating the gold bells and pomegranates around the lower hem of the robe.
passages.sermon:
God gave instructions for Aaron’s priestly robe.
Make pomegranates from blue yarn.
Make pomegranates from purple yarn.
Make pomegranates from scarlet yarn.
Place these pomegranates all around the lower hem of the robe.
Make gold bells.
Place the gold bells between the pomegranates.
Alternate a gold bell and a pomegranate around the lower hem of the robe.
Continue this pattern all the way around the hem.
passages.original: וְעָשִׂ֣יתָ עַל־ שׁוּלָ֗יו רִמֹּנֵי֙ תְּכֵ֤לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָן֙ וְתוֹלַ֣עַת שָׁנִ֔י עַל־ שׁוּלָ֖יו סָבִ֑יב וּפַעֲמֹנֵ֥י זָהָ֛ב בְּתוֹכָ֖ם סָבִֽיב׃ פַּעֲמֹ֤ן זָהָב֙ וְרִמּ֔וֹן פַּֽעֲמֹ֥ן זָהָ֖ב וְרִמּ֑וֹן עַל־ שׁוּלֵ֥י הַמְּעִ֖יל סָבִֽיב׃

passages.text: Aaron must wear the robe whenever he ministers, and its sound will be heard when he enters or exits the sanctuary before the LORD, so that he will not die.
passages.sermon:
Aaron is the high priest of Israel.
Aaron must serve God in the sanctuary.
Aaron must wear the special robe when he serves.
The robe has gold bells on its lower hem.
The bells make a sound when Aaron moves.
People will hear the sound when Aaron enters the holy place before the LORD.
People will hear the sound when Aaron leaves the holy place.
Aaron must wear the robe and make its sound so that he will not die.
passages.original: וְהָיָ֥ה עַֽל־ אַהֲרֹ֖ן לְשָׁרֵ֑ת וְנִשְׁמַ֣ע ק֠וֹלוֹ בְּבֹא֨וֹ אֶל־ הַקֹּ֜דֶשׁ לִפְנֵ֧י יְהוָ֛ה וּבְצֵאת֖וֹ וְלֹ֥א יָמֽוּת׃ס

passages.text: You are to make a plate of pure gold and engrave on it as on a seal: HOLY TO THE LORD.
passages.sermon:
God gave instructions for Aaron, the high priest of Israel.
Make a plate from pure gold.
Engrave words on the plate, like a seal.
Write these words: HOLY TO THE LORD.
passages.original: וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ צִּ֖יץ זָהָ֣ב טָה֑וֹר וּפִתַּחְתָּ֤ עָלָיו֙ פִּתּוּחֵ֣י חֹתָ֔ם קֹ֖דֶשׁ לַֽיהוָֽה׃

passages.text: Fasten to it a blue cord to mount it on the turban; it shall be on the front of the turban.
passages.sermon:
God gave instructions for Aaron, the high priest of Israel.
Aaron must wear special garments when he serves God.
One part is a plate of pure gold.
Engrave on the plate: "HOLY TO THE LORD."
Attach a blue cord to the gold plate.
Fasten the plate to the turban with the blue cord.
Place the plate on the front of the turban.
passages.original: וְשַׂמְתָּ֤ אֹתוֹ֙ עַל־ פְּתִ֣יל תְּכֵ֔לֶת וְהָיָ֖ה עַל־ הַמִּצְנָ֑פֶת אֶל־ מ֥וּל פְּנֵֽי־ הַמִּצְנֶ֖פֶת יִהְיֶֽה׃

passages.text: And it will be worn on Aaron’s forehead, so that he may bear the iniquity of the holy things that the sons of Israel consecrate with regard to all their holy gifts. It shall always be on his forehead, so that they may be acceptable before the LORD.
passages.sermon:
Aaron is the high priest of Israel.
He will wear the gold plate on his forehead.
The gold plate says, “Holy to the LORD.”
Aaron will bear the guilt of the holy things.
The Israelites bring holy gifts to God.
Aaron will carry the iniquity of these gifts.
The plate must always be on Aaron’s forehead.
This will make the gifts acceptable to the LORD.
passages.original: וְהָיָה֮ עַל־ מֵ֣צַח אַהֲרֹן֒ וְנָשָׂ֨א אַהֲרֹ֜ן אֶת־ עֲוֺ֣ן הַקֳּדָשִׁ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר יַקְדִּ֙ישׁוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לְכָֽל־ מַתְּנֹ֖ת קָדְשֵׁיהֶ֑ם וְהָיָ֤ה עַל־ מִצְחוֹ֙ תָּמִ֔יד לְרָצ֥וֹן לָהֶ֖ם לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: You are to weave the tunic with fine linen, make the turban of fine linen, and fashion an embroidered sash.
passages.sermon:
God gave instructions for the priests’ clothing.
Weave the tunic with fine linen.
Make the turban from fine linen.
Make the sash with embroidery.
passages.original: וְשִׁבַּצְתָּ֙ הַכְּתֹ֣נֶת שֵׁ֔שׁ וְעָשִׂ֖יתָ מִצְנֶ֣פֶת שֵׁ֑שׁ וְאַבְנֵ֥ט תַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה רֹקֵֽם׃

passages.text: Make tunics, sashes, and headbands for Aaron’s sons, to give them glory and splendor.
passages.sermon:
Aaron had sons.
God commanded Moses to make special clothes for Aaron’s sons.
Make tunics for Aaron’s sons.
Make sashes for them.
Make headbands for them.
These clothes will give Aaron’s sons glory.
These clothes will give Aaron’s sons splendor.
passages.original: וְלִבְנֵ֤י אַהֲרֹן֙ תַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה כֻתֳּנֹ֔ת וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ לָהֶ֖ם אַבְנֵטִ֑ים וּמִגְבָּעוֹת֙ תַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה לָהֶ֔ם לְכָב֖וֹד וּלְתִפְאָֽרֶת׃

passages.text: After you put these garments on your brother Aaron and his sons, anoint them, ordain them, and consecrate them so that they may serve Me as priests.
passages.sermon:
God chose Aaron and his sons to serve Him as priests.
You must put the special garments on Aaron and his sons.
You must anoint Aaron and his sons with oil.
You must ordain Aaron and his sons for their service.
You must consecrate Aaron and his sons to make them holy.
Then Aaron and his sons will serve God as priests.
passages.original: וְהִלְבַּשְׁתָּ֤ אֹתָם֙ אֶת־ אַהֲרֹ֣ן אָחִ֔יךָ וְאֶת־ בָּנָ֖יו אִתּ֑וֹ וּמָשַׁחְתָּ֨ אֹתָ֜ם וּמִלֵּאתָ֧ אֶת־ יָדָ֛ם וְקִדַּשְׁתָּ֥ אֹתָ֖ם וְכִהֲנ֥וּ לִֽי׃

passages.text: Make linen undergarments to cover their bare flesh, extending from waist to thigh.
passages.sermon:
God chose Aaron and his sons to serve as priests.
God commanded Moses to make special clothing for them.
Make linen undergarments for Aaron and his sons.
These undergarments must cover their bare flesh.
The undergarments must go from the waist to the thigh.
passages.original: וַעֲשֵׂ֤ה לָהֶם֙ מִכְנְסֵי־ בָ֔ד לְכַסּ֖וֹת בְּשַׂ֣ר עֶרְוָ֑ה מִמָּתְנַ֥יִם וְעַד־ יְרֵכַ֖יִם יִהְיֽוּ׃

passages.text: Aaron and his sons must wear them whenever they enter the Tent of Meeting or approach the altar to minister in the Holy Place, so that they will not incur guilt and die. This is to be a permanent statute for Aaron and his descendants.
passages.sermon:
Aaron is the brother of Moses.
Aaron has sons.
God chose Aaron and his sons to serve as priests.
Aaron and his sons must wear special garments.
They must wear these garments when they enter the Tent of Meeting.
They must also wear these garments when they approach the altar.
They serve God in the Holy Place.
If they do not wear the garments, they will be guilty.
If they do not wear the garments, they will die.
God gave this rule as a permanent law.
This law is for Aaron.
This law is for Aaron’s descendants.
passages.original: וְהָיוּ֩ עַל־ אַהֲרֹ֨ן וְעַל־ בָּנָ֜יו בְּבֹאָ֣ם׀ אֶל־ אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֗ד א֣וֹ בְגִשְׁתָּ֤ם אֶל־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֙חַ֙ לְשָׁרֵ֣ת בַּקֹּ֔דֶשׁ וְלֹא־ יִשְׂא֥וּ עָוֺ֖ן וָמֵ֑תוּ חֻקַּ֥ת עוֹלָ֛ם ל֖וֹ וּלְזַרְע֥וֹ אַחֲרָֽיו׃ס
